[Section] Methodology ::: GlossBERT ::: GlossBERT(Sent-CLS)
[source_id=31] We use context-gloss pairs as input. We take the final hidden state of the first token [CLS] as the representation of the whole sequence and add a classification layer ($label\in \lbrace yes, no\rbrace $), which does not highlight the target word.
